first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: A dark heavy firearm continuously visible in the lower part of the image, with its central front end pointing forward and segmented belt-like structures curving outward on both sides.

entities.name: Snow-Covered Rocky Battlefield
entities.identification: A ground surface composed of dark broken rocks, fractured rock platforms, and discontinuous white snow cover.

entities.name: Upper Smoke-Cloud Background
entities.identification: Smoke and a dark background in the upper part of the image, appearing yellow-orange, gray-purple, or blue-gray depending on the lighting, with occlusion by dark smoke masses.

entities.name: Robot B
entities.identification: A bipedal mechanical body near the rock platform right of center; in the early part, its outline is obscured by intense red-white light, while in the later part, its dark body, jointed legs, and red ring-shaped light around the upper body are visible.
